column1: # ZAP baseline rule overrides for ContrastAPI.
# These rules are JSON-API-irrelevant noise; landing page is intentionally minimal.
# Review quarterly: if the landing page grows, re-evaluate 10027 (could mask HTML-comment leaks).
# NOTE: Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/* paths are excluded at the spider level (see scan command),
# NOT via rule-level IGNORE — that would mask real findings on our own endpoints.
